items.example: Sorry, I'm swamped this week.
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, bu hafta işlerim çok yoğun.
items.simple: You have so much to do that you cannot do more.

items.example: Sorry, I'm running late.
items.simple: You are not on time. You come after the time you said.

items.tr: … i yetiştirmek, geride kalanı telafi etmek
items.example: I need to catch up on my emails.
items.simple: You do the things you did not have time to do before.

items.example: Can you take over for me?
items.simple: You start doing a job that another person did before.

items.example: My manager is really nice.
items.simple: The person who is the boss of a small group of workers.

items.example: I'll get back to you tomorrow.
items.simple: You do not know now, but you will tell them later.

items.example: It's six. Let's call it a day.
items.exampleTr: Saat altı. Bugünlük bu kadar yeter.
items.simple: You stop working because you did enough for today.

items.example: Can I have a word with you?
items.simple: You want to talk to someone in private for a short time.

items.example: We need to meet the deadline.
items.simple: You finish the work before the last day.

items.tr: izin almak, bir gün tatil yapmak
items.example: I'm taking a day off tomorrow.
items.simple: You do not go to work for one day and you rest.

items.example: I work from home on Fridays.
items.simple: You do your job at your house, not at the office.

items.example: Did you sign up for the course?
items.simple: You write your name so you can join something.

items.example: Don't put it off any longer.
items.simple: You do not do it now. You do it later.

items.example: I handed in my report this morning.
items.simple: You give your finished work to someone.

items.example: Sorry, I'm tied up until three.
items.simple: You cannot talk now because you are doing something else.

items.example: Which one? It's up to you.
items.simple: You can choose. It is your choice.

items.example: I'm supposed to call him back.
items.simple: This is the thing that people said you must do.

items.example: Don't worry, I'm on it.
items.simple: You are doing it now. They do not need to ask again.

items.example: She got a promotion last week.
items.simple: You get a better job at work.

items.example: The salary is quite good.
items.simple: The money you get every month for your job.

items.example: I handed in my notice today.
items.simple: You tell your work that you will go soon.

items.example: I'll keep you posted.
items.simple: You will tell them news when you have some.
